t: 英格兰国王亨利七世向约翰·卡博特和他的儿子们颁发了专利书,授权他们去探索未知的土地.
te: King Henry VII of England issues letters patent to John Cabot and his sons, authorising them to explore unknown lands.
dz: 英格兰国王亨利七世向约翰·卡博特和他的儿子们颁发了专利书,授权他们去探索未知的土地.
de: King Henry VII of England issues letters patent to John Cabot and his sons, authorising them to explore unknown lands.

t: 建立圣多明各市后，克里斯托弗·哥伦布启程前往西班牙，留下他的兄弟指挥。
te: After establishing the city of Santo Domingo, Christopher Columbus departs for Spain, leaving his brother in command.
dz: 建立圣多明各市后，克里斯托弗·哥伦布启程前往西班牙，留下他的兄弟指挥。
de: After establishing the city of Santo Domingo, Christopher Columbus departs for Spain, leaving his brother in command.

t: 葡萄牙国王曼努埃尔一世颁布法令,下令将犹太人驱逐出境.
te: King Manuel I of Portugal issues a decree ordering the expulsion of Jews from the country.
dz: 葡萄牙国王曼努埃尔一世颁布法令,下令将犹太人驱逐出境.
de: King Manuel I of Portugal issues a decree ordering the expulsion of Jews from the country.
